notes: The expressed KAI (s009) was given t012 *and*, the coordinator standing before *prayed*, while PROSEUCHOMENOS (s008) kept a bare *prayed*. That crosses s008 and s009 and relocates a conjunction from between its conjuncts to in front of the first. The ASV converts PROSEUCHOMENOS into a coordinate finite clause, so t012 is rule 88's supplied juncture on the verb it introduces, and the KAI coordinating *prayed* and *saying* has no English counterpart, the ASV writing them asyndetically. This aligns the verse with MAT.26.26, MAT.26.27, MAT.26.37, MAT.26.49, MAT.26.51 and MAT.26.58, which all give an expressed KAI the *and* at its own position and a supplied juncture to the verb.
